Method of Attack: Encrypts victim's files using XOR encryption
Displays a QR code demanding ransom payment of 110 Yuan (~$16 USD) via WeChat
Contains a development module promoted for stealing Alipay accounts and funds
Steals passwords for popular Chinese sites (Alipay, Baidu Yun, Netease 163, Tencent QQ, Taobao, Tmall, Jingdong)
Indicators of Compromise: QR code demanding ransom payment via WeChat
Attack Vector: Ransomware spread via development module containing ransomware code
